senses.gloss: f. (גָּמָא, גָּמָה, גָּמַע) quaffing, full draught.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:1">Sabb. VIII, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 76b:6">76ᵇ</cite>) <he>כדי גמיא׳</he> Ms. O. a. Ar. (ed. <he>גמיע׳</he>) as much as is quaffed at a time. Ib. 77ᵃ (discussion about spelling with <cite ref="A00000"><he>א</he></cite> or <cite ref="P00000"><he>ע</he></cite>); Tosef. ib. VIII (IX), 8 (with <cite ref="P00000"><he>ע</he></cite>); Y. ib. VIII, beg. 11ᵃ <he>גמייה</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60">Gen. R. s. 60</cite> <he>גמיי׳ אחת</he> (some ed. <cite ref="C01025"><he>גְּמִיָּה</he></cite>) only one quaff; Tanḥ. Pinḥ. 13 <he>כדי גמיא׳</he>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 21:18">Num. R. s. 21</cite> <cite ref="C01024"><he>גמייא</he></cite> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 13:5">Midr. Prov. ch. XIII</cite> <cite ref="C01022"><he>גמיאה</he></cite>.—Num. R. l. c. <he>הוא עושה גמיע׳ אחת</he> the Leviathan swallows with one quaff; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 16:1">Pesik. R. s. 16</cite> (with <cite ref="A00000"><he>א</he></cite>); a. fr.
